g.text: PostureCare Data Flow & Activity Diagram v2.0
Parse patient/session metadata and sensor payload
Normalize IMU, EMG, and SmO2 readings
Convert to Prometheus format and push to gateway (9091)
Persist patient, session, and measurement records
Publish event payloads to Redis Pub/Sub
Notify GraphQL subscribers and WebSocket listeners
Evaluate posture, EMG, SmO2, battery, and temperature thresholds
Validate X-API-Key and resolve through data_access
BI tools, mobile apps, and analytics platforms consume the API
